description: This file defines the 'BarChartRenderer' class, which is responsible for rendering bar charts within the PDFsharp charting module. It includes methods for initialization, layout, rendering/drawing of the chart, and handling different chart types like clustered and stacked bar charts.

classes.name: BarChartRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class specialized for drawing bar charts, supporting layout, rendering, and handling chart types such as 2D clustered and stacked bar charts.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes and prepares renderer-specific information for the bar chart, including axes, legends, plot area, and data labels.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates layout positions and settings for chart elements like axes, legend, and plot area, preparing for rendering.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Performs the rendering/drawing of the complete bar chart, including axes, legend, gridlines, plot area, data labels, and other visual components.

methods.name: GetPlotAreaRenderer
methods.description: Returns the specific plot area renderer based on chart type (clustered or stacked).

methods.name: GetLegendRenderer
methods.description: Returns the specific legend renderer for the chart type.

methods.name: GetYAxisRenderer
methods.description: Returns the specific Y-axis renderer depending on the chart type.

methods.name: InitSeriesRendererInfo
methods.description: Initializes data structures for rendering all series in the chart.

methods.name: InitSeries
methods.description: Sets up visual styles and point renderer info for each series involved in the chart.
